controles.affirmation: "le BPA dilue recule de 6,7% a 0,56 $ contre 0,65 $ un an plus tot"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2-FY2026, compte de resultat : "Earnings per share – diluted $ 0.56 $ 0.65" ; MD&A : "Diluted earnings per share was $0.56 and $0.65 in the second quarters of 2026 and 2025, respectively."
controles.correction_proposee: 0,56 / 0,65 = -13,8%, pas -6,7%. Ecrire "le BPA dilue recule de 13,8%". Le -6,7% n'existe nulle part dans la source.

controles.affirmation: "McCormick a signe un term loan en avril 2026 et paye 729,9 M$ nets de tresorerie acquise pour prendre le controle de McCormick de Mexico", sous le titre "Endettement en hausse pour financer le rachat de la participation majoritaire"
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K du 1er mai 2026 : "On April 28, 2026, McCormick ... entered into a Term Loan Agreement ... in connection with the financing of McCormick's pending combination with the foods business of Unilever PLC ... The Term Loan Agreement provides McCormick with the ability to borrow up to $2.0 billion at the closing of the Merger ... for the purpose of financing a portion of the cash consideration to be paid in the Merger". 10-Q T2-FY2026, Note 2 : "The purchase of the additional 25 % ownership interest was funded through a combination of cash on hand and commercial paper borrowings."
controles.correction_proposee: Le term loan d'avril 2026 (facilite de 2,0 Mds $, tirable seulement au closing) finance la fusion avec l'activite Foods d'Unilever, PAS l'acquisition de McCormick de Mexico, qui a ete financee par de la tresorerie et du papier commercial. Dissocier les deux operations.

controles.affirmation: "les charges speciales liees a l'acquisition passent de 12,8 M$ a 60,0 M$ sur le trimestre" (acquisition = McCormick de Mexico)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2-FY2026, Note 3 : "During the three months ended May 31, 2026, we recorded $60.0 million of special charges, including transaction and integration expenses. Those expenses consisted of $57.6 million of transaction and integration costs, $1.8 million associated with employee severance and related benefits associated with our SG&A streamlining actions and $0.6 million associated with other actions." Aucune ventilation par operation n'est publiee ; le trimestre (mars-mai 2026) couvre la signature du Merger Agreement Unilever du 31 mars 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q n'attribue pas ces 60,0 M$ a l'acquisition de McCormick de Mexico. Ecrire : "les charges speciales, essentiellement des couts de transaction et d'integration, passent de 12,8 M$ a 60,0 M$" sans designer l'operation.

controles.affirmation: Omission : l'ATT ne mentionne nulle part la fusion annoncee avec l'activite Foods d'Unilever
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2-FY2026 : "On March 31, 2026, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger ... with Unilever PLC to combine with the Unilever Foods business ... The transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement are expected to result in current Unilever shareholders owning approximately 55.1 % of the combined company, our current shareholders owning approximately 35.0 % of the combined company ... Unilever will also receive a one-time $ 15.7 billion cash payment".
controles.correction_proposee: Lacune materielle grave pour une anti-these vendue a des investisseurs : l'operation dilue les actionnaires actuels de McCormick a environ 35% du nouvel ensemble et implique un paiement cash de 15,7 Mds $. Elle doit figurer dans l'ATT.
